extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.16.0 - Lighter and quicker: no longer needs the requests module, so lists that fetch from an addon start sooner. Home rows and hub rows show their last list at once when it has expired and refresh it in the background. With Arctic Zephyr Stremio: after an episode or film is stopped part-way, only Continue Watching, Next Up and the watchlist reload, and the setup wizard offers YouTube and Up Next when they're missing. v0.15.0 - Back up and restore Kodi (every profile, add-on and setting) in Settings > Backup. Faster start for every list (about half the start-up). Smaller artwork downloads. Info pages of Continue Watching and Next Up are read ahead. Play says how much is left. The watchlist shows each title's full details. With Arctic Zephyr Stremio: switch profile from a list, a status bar while streams are found, quicker search typing. v0.14.2 - Up Next: Watch now (or the countdown) starts the next episode itself; Kodi no longer says it can't find a next item to play.

extension.description: Browse Apple's top podcasts and genre charts, search, subscribe and play episodes. My Latest Episodes picks up where you left off and lists new episodes from the podcasts you follow. Optional gPodder sync (oPodSync, gpodder.net or Nextcloud gPodder Sync) keeps subscriptions and play positions the same across your Kodi devices.
extension.disclaimer: Podcast listings come from Apple; episodes play straight from each podcast's own feed.
extension.news: v1.0.5 - New setting: Hide played episodes, which leaves them out of every list. v1.0.4 - My Unplayed Podcasts lists podcasts with episodes waiting (and how many); My Latest Episodes shows each podcast's oldest unplayed episode, filling gaps, or episode 1 of one you haven't started. v1.0.3 - New My Unplayed Podcasts (subscriptions you haven't started); My Latest Episodes shows the next episode by release date after the last one you played, not the newest. v1.0.2 - Home-screen widgets made from My Podcasts or My Latest Episodes refresh after you play, mark, subscribe or sync (re-add existing widgets once). v1.0.1 - Played episodes are dimmed and marked Played (Kodi shows no watched tick for audio); Go to podcast now works from home-screen widgets. v1.0.0 - First release: My Podcasts, My Latest Episodes, Trending (Apple genre charts), Top Podcasts, Search, resume, and gPodder sync.

extension.summary: Choose which Dispatcharr source a live TV channel plays
extension.description: For IPTV Simple channels served by Dispatcharr: long-press OK/Select while watching (or use "Choose source" on a channel or guide entry) to see the channel's source streams and switch to another, or skip to the next one. Dispatcharr switches the source on the server, so the channel keeps playing with its guide and channel info.
extension.news: v1.0.1 - Long-press OK/Select (not Play/Pause) while watching opens the source picker. v1.0.0 - First release.

extension.summary: Keep Kodi's artwork cache and add-on downloads small
extension.description: Every few days, removes cached artwork Kodi hasn't shown recently and the add-on zips Kodi keeps after installing. Kodi downloads any artwork it needs again. Made for low-storage devices like Fire TV Sticks.

addon.name: Arctic Zephyr Stremio
addon.provider-name: shiggsy365 (based on Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded by jurialmunkey, beatmasterRS)

extension.news: v1.4.0 - Lighter: the menus are checked once a session instead of every time Home opens, 36 fewer fonts load with the skin, and the lyrics screen is gone. YouTube (trailers) and Up Next are no longer required; the setup wizard offers them. Info page: Down now reaches the episodes of a show with only one season. v1.3.0 - The home menu moves to the top and slides away as you browse; Up opens a section's sub-menu. Search: typing is quicker and spaces land in the right place. Info page: placeholders while it loads, progress on part-watched episodes, one-season shows list their episodes straight away. A status bar while streams are found. Search beside the clock. Pick a profile from a list. Back up and restore buttons in the skin settings. v1.2.7 - With several Kodi profiles: a profile picker beside the clock, and home widgets per profile. Context menus open without Kodi's showing first. The info page hides the last title's lists while it loads; hub rows refresh in place again.
extension.summary: Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded, made for Stremio Bridge.
extension.description: A fork of Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded by beatmasterRS, itself based on Arctic: Zephyr by jurialmunkey, made to work with Stremio Bridge and Dispatcharr Bridge. Clean, minimal and light, with the layout of Reloaded. Licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, like the original.
Kodi repository for shiggsy365's add-ons, including Stremio Bridge. Updates install automatically.
